title: Professional Rust Tooling and Team Workflows
learning_outcomes: Explain and apply core ideas from Professional Rust Tooling and Team Workflows.
Trace one small example and identify a meaningful edge case.
Use official documentation to check details that depend on the toolchain or ecosystem.

notes: Adopt repeatable tooling, dependency, version-control, CI, and upgrade workflows. A professional workflow automates formatting, linting, tests, dependency review, and reproducible builds. Review edition migrations and public API changes before merging.
